details:
Currently, when a user purchases a VRC+ Gift Drop bundle (10, 50, 100, etc.), the entire bundle must be dropped at once.

I would like users to be able to choose how many gifts they want to distribute from a bundle while keeping the remaining gifts for later use.

For example, in my case, I have gifted more than 60 months of VRC+ over the last two months. If I could purchase a bundle of 100 gifts at the discounted price, I would like to be able to:

Drop 5 gifts during one event.

Drop 10 gifts the following week.

Drop 20 gifts during another event.

Keep the remaining gifts for future events, giveaways, or community rewards.

Instead, the current system forces users to distribute all 100 gifts at the same time, which significantly reduces the usefulness of larger bundles.

A simple solution would be:

Purchase a bundle of 10, 50, or 100 gifts.

Display the remaining number of gifts on the account.

Allow users to choose exactly how many gifts to drop each time.

Automatically keep the unused gifts for future Gift Drops.

This would be especially useful for event organizers, community leaders, streamers, content creators, and users who regularly gift VRC+ to others.

It would also encourage more users to purchase larger bundles since they could benefit from the discounted pricing without being forced to distribute every gift at once.
title: Allow Partial Gift Drops from VRC+ Gift Bundles
